content.what_it_is: Interactive 2-D check script for the beach_2d case: animates surface-elevation snapshots for output files 20-90 (nfile @L4). Loads dep.out @L5; per frame loads eta_ @L11 and mask_ @L13 (etasrn_ load commented @L12); left subplot (121) is effectively empty in the shipped state — the pcolor of etasrn-eta is commented @L16, leaving only caxis([-0.2 0.2]) @L17 and axis window @L18; right subplot (122): NaNs dry cells eta(mask<1)=NaN @L21, pcolor(eta) @L22 with caxis([-1 1]) @L23 and axis([200 250 1 500]) @L24; pause(0.1) between frames @L25.
entities: script; clear all @L1; variables: fdir @L2; nfile @L4; dep @L5; num @L7; fnum @L10; eta @L11; mask @L13

io.name: eta_ @L11, mask_ @L13 per frame; etasrn_ commented @L12

calls: builtins: load, sprintf, clf, subplot, pcolor/shading, caxis, axis, pause
unresolved: The left subplot's plotting line is commented out @L16 (etasrn-eta difference view), so subplot(121) renders empty axes with fixed caxis/axis — leftover from debugging the etasrn ('screen' eta) field; dep is loaded @L5 but never used
